Nostradamus 'Coming soon' + Aura visible).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Add friends to see who really knows ball.' empty-state message never renders because backend /api/leaderboard?board=friends_alltime always returns me as the sole row in data.top when I have no accepted friends, so data?.top.length === 0 is false and ListEmptyComponent doesn't fire. UX result: user sees themself alone in top AND again as sticky 'You', with no messaging that they should add friends. Suggest changing the check at leaderboard.tsx:122-136 to also fire empty state when scope==='friends' and top.length<=1 and top[0].user_id===user.user_id.

action_items: (UX) leaderboard.tsx: fire the 'Add friends to see who really knows ball.' empty-state when the friends board top has only me (currently unreachable because backend always includes me in the friends list).
No backend fixes required — all 15 pytest tests pass, all requested backend flows verified including the previously-untested lobby match-win XP flow, xp_events logging, and L5 reward unlock.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1402-1416 lobby match-win folding: correctly gates match-win XP behind `if res.modified_count` (using update_one status change from non-completed to completed) so match_wins is awarded exactly once across concurrent /score calls — verified via idempotency test.

progression.py:243-268 check_achievements loop runs a second pass so that XP awarded from an achievement can push the user across a rank/level threshold and unlock additional achievements in the same request — nice defensive design; also guards duplicates via update_one with $setOnInsert + upsert.

progression.py:174-175 effective_weekly_xp returns 0 when week_key differs from current — but lazy weekly reset in award_xp_batch only runs when XP is being awarded. Users who don't play for a week will show stale weekly_xp in /api/progression if _finalize_summary isn't called. Currently mitigated by effective_weekly_xp gating, so functionally fine but the underlying stored value can drift.

server.py:485-527 leaderboard: friends board always includes me in the pool (ids = {me['user_id']} union friends). This is fine for showing my own row but conflicts with the frontend's ListEmptyComponent logic — see the ui_bug above.

server.py:1385-1388 lobby /score: fallback_diff for a 'normal' lobby maps to 'hard' (via `{...}.get(..., 'hard')`). This is because DIFFICULTIES here are lobby-difficulties (casual/normal/hard/expert/deepcut/mixed) whereas progression XP uses solo-quiz difficulties (easy/medium/hard). The 'normal' mapping to 'hard' feels off — most 'normal' lobby answers will earn 25 XP each instead of 15. Consider mapping normal→medium (which XP_CORRECT has as 15). This is a design/intent question rather than a bug.

progression.py:104 XP_CORRECT includes both 'medium' and 'normal' as 15 XP already, so the fallback_diff='hard' choice for normal lobbies at server.py:1384 appears inconsistent. Either drop the mapping (rely on XP_CORRECT.get(diff, 15)) or map normal→medium.
